$comment: Read by ~/.claude/hooks/harness-gate.py. `staging`: finished work merges there; nothing but `release` reaches main (no PR, merge or push into main). `check_prs`: a PR into staging that changes any of `paths` needs a passing `command` verdict for the branch's HEAD tree in <main checkout>/.harness/verdicts/. The release runs `command` again on staging's combined tree.
